title: Dusk Blocks — A Calm Block Puzzle for iPhone
desc: Dusk Blocks is a calm 8×8 block puzzle for iPhone. Place three pieces, clear lines, and enjoy daily puzzles, soft line clears, and one-handed play.
short: A calm 8×8 block puzzle for iPhone with daily puzzles, soft line clears, and one-handed play.
lead: Calm block puzzle, tuned for quiet evenings. Place 3 pieces on an 8×8 board, clear lines, and keep the board flowing at your own pace.
chips: Rewarded continue only when you choose it
feats: The next three pieces always have a way to fit, so every run starts fair and calm.
Daily puzzle, one seed per day
A fresh board every day, generated from the date for a quiet daily habit.
Line clears feel soft and rewarding
Subtle motion, score pops, and a color-line bonus for clearing a single-color row.
caps: A calm first look at the 8×8 puzzle and the three-piece tray.
Begin with an easy opening and keep the board flexible.
Smooth placement designed for quick, quiet play.
Clear a line, feel the flow.
Lines disappear with a soft burst and make room for the next move.
Plan ahead and keep the board from locking up.
The run ends cleanly with your score and best score in view.
A rewarded continue appears only when you choose it.
store_p: The App Store release is coming soon.
